answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Earnings unlock over 100 epochs; a farmed identity cannot cash out before it is judged. A kernel of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the oasis of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and prism-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
